description: Researched date ranges for records the pipeline left undated. Sources: filename annotations, yearbook/newspaper mastheads, postmarks, the San Gorgonio Pass Historical Society timeline, Beaumont institutional histories, and visual analysis (vehicles, dress, architecture, postcard format).

confidence_levels.confirmed: explicit date in the image, filename, masthead, postmark, or a source annotation
confidence_levels.high: strong single anchor (dated postcard series, documented construction year, decisive visual cue)
confidence_levels.medium: reasoned from era cues or a subject's known active period
confidence_levels.low: broad but defensible range; further confirmation welcome

img_650198dd9e4987ea.basis: The album mount is typed 'BEAUMONT 1907' and Calisphere dates the item 1907 (CBEA_011). Corrects the catalog's erroneous 'stagecoach, 1860'.

img_6f833a14a7764e47.basis: Calisphere carries no date for the photo; the depot was built 1887. c. 1905-1915 rests on the crowd's dress, the long steel consist and the electric/telegraph poles (editorial estimate, flagged as such). Dress (women in jeans/work shirts) fits the 1940s. Supersedes the filename-guess range 1915-1940.
